The salon

Eleven years, locally owned

Locally owned and operated, eleven years in business — Glamour's own listing highlight, and 878 reviews across Google, Yelp and Vagaro back it up.

Regulars here don't book a service, they book a person. Jenny, Vi, Mia, Nikkie and Tiffany all get named by first name in the reviews — several of them by customers who have been coming back for years for the same pair of hands.

The board on the wall runs the whole shop: manicures, pedicures, acrylic, dip powder, hard gel, waxing, and a kids' list for ages three to eleven. Green towel, warm light, a chair at the marble bar, and a set that goes home with you.
